items.name: Ace Trainer
items.description: A battle-focused Trainer Path that raises the accuracy and damage potential of the whole team.

details.label: Level 2: Ace Trainer
details.value: All of your Pokémon gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

details.label: Level 5: Battle Master
details.value: Grant Pokémon a limited pool of d6 battle dice for attack or damage rolls; the pool returns after a long rest.

details.label: Level 9: Tactical Mastery
details.value: Increase one chosen ability score for every current and future Pokémon; battle dice become d8s.

details.label: Level 15: Rapid Switching
details.value: A switched-in Pokémon can take one action or move that turn; battle dice become d10s.

items.name: Hobbyist
items.description: A versatile Trainer Path that broadens personal and Pokémon skill coverage.

details.label: Level 2: Hobbyist
details.value: Choose an extra Specialization and gain two new Trainer skill proficiencies.

details.label: Level 5: Versatile
details.value: Grant Pokémon a limited pool of d6 skill dice for skill checks or saving throws.

details.label: Level 9: Generalist
details.value: Apply half proficiency to skills you or your Pokémon lack; skill dice become d8s.

details.label: Level 15: Multitalented
details.value: Each Pokémon gains one chosen skill proficiency; skill dice become d10s.

items.name: Poké Mentor
items.description: A teaching-focused Trainer Path that improves TM use and Move development.

details.label: Level 2: Poké Mentor
details.value: TMs can be used twice before they break.

details.label: Level 5: Retention
details.value: The Extra Move feat costs one ASI point instead of two.

details.label: Level 9: Cheerleader
details.value: Once per short rest, use a bonus action to boost allied attack rolls, damage rolls, or AC until your next turn.

details.label: Level 15: Master Teacher
details.value: Pokémon can learn and unlearn Moves on each long rest rather than only on level-up.

items.name: Researcher
items.description: A knowledge-focused Trainer Path for investigating Pokémon and their evolution.

details.label: Level 2: Researcher
details.value: A limited number of times per long rest, add your Intelligence modifier to a Pokémon skill check.

details.label: Level 5: Analyst
details.value: Win a contested Investigation check to learn a target's Ability and one Move.

details.label: Level 9: Evolution Expert
details.value: When a Pokémon evolves, two Evolution Points may be spent on a feat.

details.label: Level 15: Professor
details.value: Use Analyst as a bonus action and reveal one extra Ability or Move.

items.name: Pokémon Collector
items.description: A collection-focused Trainer Path for capturing, protecting, and tracking Pokémon.

details.label: Level 2: Pokémon Collector
details.value: Gain expertise in Animal Handling.

details.label: Level 5: Gotta Catch 'Em All
details.value: Once per long rest, make an Animal Handling capture check with advantage.

details.label: Level 9: Disciplined Strikes
details.value: When a damaging hit would faint a Pokémon, you may leave it at 1 HP instead.

details.label: Level 15: Expert Tracker
details.value: Use Pokémon Tracker twice per long rest and target a chosen wild Pokémon with a successful check.

items.name: Nurse
items.description: A recovery-focused Trainer Path that strengthens Pokémon healing and medical support.

details.label: Level 2: Nurse
details.value: Gain Medicine proficiency; healing a Pokémon restores additional HP equal to your Wisdom modifier.

details.label: Level 5: Pokéchef
details.value: Prepare a limited number of healing treats that restore 2d4 + 2 HP.

details.label: Level 9: Field Medic
details.value: Use a Medicine check to cure an adjacent Pokémon's non-volatile status; treats heal 3d10 + 6 HP.

details.label: Level 15: Tip-top Shape
details.value: Pokémon gain advantage against negative status conditions; treats heal 4d12 + 10 HP.

items.name: Type Master
items.description: A type-specialist Trainer Path that strengthens Pokémon matching your Specializations.

details.label: Level 2: Type Master
details.value: Pokémon matching your Specialization gain +1 STAB; dual matches gain +2.

details.label: Level 5: Drawing Power
details.value: Matching Pokémon gain +2 to attack rolls.

details.label: Level 9: Storing Power
details.value: Matching carried Pokémon gain resistance to one chosen Specialization type.

details.label: Level 15: Releasing Power
details.value: Matching Pokémon can apply STAB to a damaging Move of a different type.

items.name: Commander
items.description: A Bonds supplement Trainer Path that develops a team's Bond Levels and Bond Points.

details.label: Level 2: Commander
details.value: Your starter's Bond Level becomes +2 and Pokémon with a positive Bond Level gain one Bond Point.

details.label: Level 5: Follow Me
details.value: Newly caught or hatched Pokémon gain +1 Bond Level, and battle losses cannot reduce Bond Level.

details.label: Level 9: Show Me What You've Got
details.value: Once per Pokémon per long rest, spend a Bond Point to use a Move one tier above its current tier.

details.label: Level 15: We're a Team
details.value: Use your reaction to let one Pokémon share a Bond Point benefit with an allied Pokémon.

items.name: Grunt
items.description: A villain-team Trainer Path that spends Shadow Points on disruptive battlefield tactics.

details.label: Level 2: Grunt
details.value: Gain a long-rest Shadow Point pool equal to Trainer level and use Sabotage to reduce a hit's total toward a miss.

details.label: Level 5: Dark Advantage
details.value: Spend Shadow Points to grant advantage to a Trainer or Pokémon skill check, attack roll, or saving throw.

details.label: Level 9: Sinister Dodge
details.value: Spend Shadow Points as a reaction to improve a Pokémon's resistance against a damaging Move.

details.label: Level 15: Nefarious Stagger
details.value: Spend Shadow Points when inflicting Flinched to inflict Stunned instead.

items.name: Tactician
items.description: A combat-control Trainer Path that spends Tactical Points to improve healing, offense, and defense.

details.label: Level 2: Tactician
details.value: Gain a long-rest Tactical Point pool equal to Trainer level; points can increase Pokémon healing.

details.label: Level 5: Directed Strike
details.value: Spend Tactical Points to roll an attack's damage twice and keep the higher result.

details.label: Level 9: Raise Your Defenses
details.value: Spend Tactical Points as a reaction to add to a Pokémon's AC or saving throw when that changes the outcome.

details.label: Level 15: Not This Time
details.value: Spend Tactical Points to increase a Move's save DC when doing so turns a save into a failure.

items.name: Ranger
items.description: A wilderness Trainer Path for travel, tracking, capture work, and a chosen Pokémon partner.

details.label: Level 2: Ranger
details.value: Gain Nature and Survival proficiency, faster walking speed, and climbing and swimming movement.

details.label: Level 5: Capture Styler
details.value: Encircling a Pokémon with your movement gives +10 to capture it.

details.label: Level 9: Partners
details.value: Choose a daily partner Pokémon that adds your Wisdom modifier to skill checks and attacks against wild Pokémon.

details.label: Level 15: Poké Assist
details.value: Your partner enables advantage for matching Moves and capture checks against Pokémon sharing its type.

items.name: Guru
items.description: A connection-focused Trainer Path that develops shared mental, physical, and spiritual Pokémon strength.

details.label: Level 2: Guru
details.value: Your permanent maximum controllable SR increases by 1.

details.label: Level 5: Mind
details.value: Pokémon gain Wisdom save proficiency and better outcomes when confused.

details.label: Level 9: Body
details.value: Pokémon can access two Abilities and gain a reduced Tireless feat cost.

details.label: Level 15: Spirit
details.value: A limited number of times per long rest, add your Wisdom modifier to all Pokémon attack or damage rolls for a round.

items.name: Pokémon Breeder
items.description: A Breeding supplement Trainer Path for improving hatching, inherited traits, and egg outcomes.

details.label: Level 2: Pokémon Breeder
details.value: Add your Wisdom modifier to the d20 roll when breeding two Pokémon.

details.label: Level 5: Tender Love and Care
details.value: Gain advantage on rolls that reduce a Pokémon egg's incubation counter.

details.label: Level 9: Good Genes
details.value: Hatched Pokémon gain two points for ability scores or a feat.

details.label: Level 15: Enhanced Diversity
details.value: Future hatched Pokémon can inherit one qualifying Move known by a parent.
